manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve a disclosure page where multiple current-year non-target documents coexist with only a previous-year 修学支援 target-form PDF.
search_queries: 中央動物専門学校 高等教育の修学支援新制度 申請書様式第2号 2025年度
中央動物専門学校 令和8年度 機関要件確認申請書 様式第2号
steps: Confirm the page contains current-year non-target signals such as 令和8年度運営計画 and committee dates including 令和8年1月20日.
Scroll to 高等教育の修学支援新制度 and inspect the 申請書様式第2号 link.
Confirm the only visible target-form anchor is labeled 2025年度 and resolves to https://www.chuo-a.ac.jp/disclosure/pdf/confirmation_2.pdf.
Open the PDF and verify the body contains 中央動物専門学校 and 専門学校用の様式第２号 sub-forms.
Keep it as latest-public publication-lag evidence for FY2026 because no local link or PDF evidence proves 令和8年度 target-form publication.

reusable_rules: Use the local anchor text 2025年度 as stale fiscal-year evidence for the target-form PDF.
Keep the latest public 申請書様式第2号 PDF visible to operators as publication-lag evidence when no FY2026 target-form link exists.
Separate current-year non-target disclosure links such as 運営計画, 委員会議事録, and 職業実践専門課程様式4 from strict target-form year evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not upgrade confirmation_2.pdf to FY2026 strict success because the same page has 令和8年度運営計画.
Do not treat 令和8年1月 committee meeting dates as target fiscal-year evidence for the support-system form.
Do not confuse 職業実践専門課程の様式4 PDFs with 修学支援新制度の申請書様式第2号.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found a disclosure page with current-year non-target signals including 令和8年度運営計画, while the 高等教育の修学支援新制度 申請書様式第2号 link is labeled 2025年度. Source-side PDF text extraction verified 中央動物専門学校 and 専門学校用の様式第２号 sub-form text; this must remain publication_lag_latest_public for FY2026, not strict current-FY success.
